description: This file defines an interface for an FTP client used within the Apache OFBiz framework, outlining methods for connecting, copying files, listing directories, setting transfer modes, and closing connections.

classes.name: FtpClientInterface
classes.description: An interface for FTP client operations such as connect, copy, list, set transfer modes, and disconnect.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the FTP server with specified hostname, credentials, port, and timeout.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies a file to the connected server at the specified path with the given filename.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists directory contents at the specified path.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Sets the transfer mode to binary or ASCII.

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Sets the connection to passive mode or active mode.
